These bounded fixtures retain the selected original Form 3 filing and exact
OpenFEC aggregate/report/identity responses used by the FEC source lane.
Files named by a lowercase SHA-256 digest contain those exact publisher bytes;
`selection.json` records URLs, original digests, scopes and capture dates.
The historical filing's capture time is unknown and stays null.

`sector-observations.json` is a bounded selection of native prerequisite fields,
not an original source file. It records the exact accepted FEC and lobbying-lane
generation/table pins and source-backed curator mapping. Its monetary source
population proof is separate from the original visual review retained in the
source-completion handoff. No fixture pass establishes publication acceptance.
